# Othmane Outaghza

> Othmane Outaghza is a Technical SEO Consultant and AI Automation Specialist based in Morocco. He helps e-commerce and service businesses improve organic traffic, technical SEO performance, AI search visibility, and revenue through automation, structured data, GEO, and data-driven SEO systems.

## About

Othmane Outaghza specializes in technical SEO, e-commerce SEO, AI search optimization, Generative Engine Optimization, structured data, and SEO automation. His work focuses on improving crawlability, indexability, organic search performance, and visibility across Google Search and AI search platforms.
